speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development with the impending digitalisation of the Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) process (a) whether the related website and apps will be available in the four national languages for users who are less familiar with the English language; (b) whether smart technology will be leveraged on to provide relevant recommendations, fill up forms and skip irrelevant features based on the users’ profile; and (c)whether residents will get access to training and assistance with registering their LPA through the system.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: For example, if a user indicates his intent to appoint only one donee, the online form will not have a field on how multiple donees should act.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: These features will make the LPA-making process quicker and more convenient.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Will the digitalised LPA be made available in NEHR to facilitate ease of use by clinicians?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Second, how does the Ministry intend to improve LPA awareness and better outreach to seniors with the digitalisation of the LPA processes?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I think we want to confine this to these three groups of people, because to determine whether the donor and donee should be qualified for the LPA is a very important legal process.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We will keep it to that for now, and then in the future when there are needs to do so, we will expand.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: For the second question, certainly, we will do as much as we can to reach out to our seniors.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We have a good system of outreaching with them, either through the Silver Generation Ambassadors (SGA), AIC if they are visiting them, or even PA when they come to our contact points.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Just a quick supplementary question to the Minister.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: I think the importance of LPA is obvious and certainly more so for the seniors, the elderly.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: My supplementary question to Minister is whether, currently, is he able to let us know how many of us have already done our LPAs?

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Whatever the number is, I think it is not enough.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: So, my question is, how can we accelerate this and bring this to a much higher level?

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: And it should really start at a much younger age, where possible.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: And maybe at certain appropriate milestones, we can incorporate this to increase the adoption.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I usually will ask the Member to file a Parliamentary Question for that, but I happen to have the number here.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I think the number is still small and I agree with the Member that we should encourage our friends, even ourselves, to take up the LPA.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Do not take it for granted until the last minute, when there are things that you need to get someone to handle your legal affairs, your personal affairs and that someone is not authorised to do so.
